runtime_session_receipt.schema_note: Not the codex_runtime_session_receipt.v1 shape used by TASK-20260811-338053: that schema encodes a separately launched `codex exec` probe session, and this task launched no probe. Fields that schema fills from a probe are absent here rather than filled with invented values.

identity.recorded_at_note: No sub-day timestamp is asserted: this session exposes no clock reading to this role, and inventing one would be fabrication.
identity.session_id_note: No session UUID is exposed to this role; none is invented.

resolved.backend_source: orchestration/model-bindings.yaml -> defaults.backend (no backend override was requested by the handoff)
resolved.resolved_model_id_source: runtime self-report of the model serving this session, stated at session level
resolved.manual_model_override_note: .claude/agents/coordinator.md carries `model: inherit`, so no per-task model identifier was selected by hand. Hand-selecting one is the exact defect recorded as PRODUCER-POLICY-RESOLUTION-BINDING against TASK-20260811-338053, and it did not recur.
resolved.reasoning_effort_source: .claude/agents/coordinator.md frontmatter `effort: high`, derived from orchestration/roles.yaml default_policy coordinator-orchestration-code -> orchestration/model-policies.yaml policies.coordinator-orchestration-code.reasoning_effort

verification.verification_scope_note: The model identity recorded here is a session-level attribute of the single session that emitted the authoring tokens for this task's declared deliverables. There is no second session for this receipt to be about. This is the exact structural gap that made TASK-20260811-338053's probe receipt inadmissible as authoring provenance, and it is closed here by construction rather than by assertion.
verification.probe_session_executed_reason: This role's tool surface in this runtime is Read, Grep, Glob, Write, Edit and SendMessage. It has no command-execution surface, so `python -m orchestration.adapter doctor --probe`, `tools/check_runtime_bindings.py`, and any `codex exec`-style probe are all impossible from here. No probe result is claimed.
verification.what_this_receipt_establishes: That the requested policy coordinator-orchestration-code resolves under the committed anthropic binding to claude-opus-5; that claude-opus-5 is the model the runtime reports as serving this session; that no model override was issued; and that no fallback, degradation, or Bedrock path was taken.
verification.what_this_receipt_does_not_establish: It is not a provider-side attestation, not an independently observed record, and not a probe. The committed binding's own last_probed field is null, so the identifier has never been probe-stamped on this backend. A future session for this lane that holds a command surface must supply the probe; this residual is recorded as A-R1 in the design repair report and in the successor specification.

hashes.note: This session computed no SHA-256. Every hash appearing in its deliverables is a citation of a literal already committed in a named record, and the source of each is named in place. No future, predicted, or placeholder hash is asserted anywhere.

git.note: The dispatching session stages and commits the declared paths after this task returns. This session asserts no commit, parent, tree, branch, or dirtiness state.
